rationale: The working diagnosis identifies unknown eligibility yield and bespoke technical and legal cost as the binding economic limiter. This is a material redesign, not prose polishing: it narrows the broad failure-and-counterparty scope to one module linear-performance-warranty archetype, changes acquisition from individual referrals to prepaid portfolio batches through O&M firms and lessors, removes continuous monitoring from the wedge, and gates every costly test behind a protocol-specific screen. It preserves the defensible identity of a contract-screened evidence desk while reducing cash-cycle and failed-case exposure. It does not manufacture customers, partner commitments, enforceable rights, accepted claims, margins, or recoveries; those remain explicit unknowns.
